profile.headline: Senior software engineer at Ripple
profile.summary: Results-driven senior software engineer with over 6 years of experience developing robust solutions across financial technology and digital media industries. My technical expertise spans Java, Python, GraphQL, Apache Kafka, SQL, TypeScript, C#, AWS, and Docker, allowing me to tackle complex engineering challenges across the full development stack.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Built APIs in Python and GraphQL to support artist services on our web and mobile apps
• Led the planning and technical work needed for an internal tool that tracked rising trends in artist's track performance
• Wrote, deployed, and tested Kafka consumers to process artists' track edits
• Built out "split pay" feature to calculate and attribute royalties to multiple parties
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Kafka · Python (Programming Language) · Apollo GraphQL · Git · Flask

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Generated new statistical insights for games and players in the NBC Sports Scores app
• Maintained and updated the NBC Sports Scores app based on NBC's feedback and changes
from our data provider
• Automated generation of play timestamps in baseball video streams by developing a
convolutional neural network

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Led and built the front and backend of a Premiere Pro plugin that enabled video editors to use Thuuz's automated highlights to create and edit generated highlight reels directly in Premiere Pro
• Presented the Premiere Pro plugin I built to the media arm of one of the world's largest sports leagues and collaborated with them to meet their needs
• Built out web scrapers to enhance and improve data in the NBC Sports Scores app

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: • Developed web scrapers to ingest game data from the MLB, NFL, and NCAA

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
•Worked in the Sanz lab researching lupus
•Analyzed data and created graphs using R and MATLAB

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•Analyzed big data from previous seasons of national sports leagues including the NHL and NFL, to create more accurate algorithms for producing informative metadata
•Built clear graphs for an insightful depiction of the data using R and python

courses.name: Computer Modeling for Scientists and Engineers

volunteerExperiences.description: Over several summers, I assisted with administrative work such as electronic filing, keeping track of hours, and organizing payroll. I also assisted with various games and activities ranging from themed parties for the residents, to art classes and bingo.
